text:
mika: publish for sample-sdk failed in CI, weirdly the prepublish step bumped patch twice and npm rejected duplicate version. seeing typegen output change + auth hook retrying token refresh. cc devex?
ci-bot: [CI] publish job failed: publish:sdk (exit 1) 
ci-bot: changed files: package.json, src/models.ts
noah: do you have the small diff? trying to see if it's a real API change or ordering noise.
mika: tiny type diff from regen:
```diff
-  "Color": {
-    "enum": ["red", "green", "blue"]
-  }
+  "Color": {
+    "enum": ["green", "red", "blue"]
+  }
```
tia: that enum reordering is nondeterministic from the codegen's map iteration. we've hit this before. But why did package.json get bumped twice?
mika: logs show prepublish hook runs a script that checks git diff and does `npm version patch --no-git-tag-version` when diffs exist. it ran, then auth-retry retried the publish and ran hook again after token refresh. both attempts committed version bump in CI workspace.
ops-bot: [infra] npm token refresh triggered automatic re-auth after 401 during publish attempt.
noah: ahhh. so race between auth retry and version-bump hook. two sequential runs in same CI job modified package.json twice. we should never mutate workspace during publish retry.
tia: agreed. quick mitigations: (1) make prepublish hook idempotent and avoid committing in CI (use ephemeral bump only), (2) canonicalize enums before typegen to avoid spurious diffs, (3) make auth retry non-mutating or prevent hooks from running on retry.
mika: for immediate unblock i'll revert the double-bumped version and force-publish the intended version by manually running publish with a fresh token in a single attempt. opening PR to: add spec canonicalizer + move version bump out of publish retry path.
oops-bot: [note] also file a ticket to add a deterministic-hash check in typegen CI: compute stable type signature (sorted keys + enum order) and compare against baseline.
noah: long term we should vendor a deterministic generator binary for CI so builds are reproducible. but canonicalizer + stable-hash test gets us most of the way.
tia: i'll update the release checklist: "run spec canonicalizer" and "ensure publish retries do not mutate workspace".
mika: thanks all, i'll link PR and the rollback commit shortly. :thumbsup:
